terms.title: Good to know
items: Used in full in a single visit.
Valid for 12 months from the day we confirm the payment.

items.q: How do I pay for a Golden Beauty Studio gift card?
items.a: By bank transfer, or in cash at the studio. When you order online you see the transfer details; send the receipt on WhatsApp with the card's code and, once the payment is confirmed, the card is activated and you get the link to gift it.

items.q: When does the gift card link arrive?
items.a: The link arrives on WhatsApp as soon as the payment is confirmed, during studio hours: Monday to Saturday, 1 to 7 p.m. You can order the card days ahead and give it whenever you like, since it is valid for 12 months from payment.

items.q: Which services can the gift card pay for?
items.a: Any service at the studio: gel polish, press-on, full sets, refills, overlays and extras. The card's value comes off the bill for that visit; if the service costs more, the difference is paid at the studio with any method.

items.q: Can the gift card be used across several visits?
items.a: No. The gift card is used in full in a single visit. If the service costs less than the card, the difference is not refunded in cash, so it's worth choosing the amount with the service she'd like in mind.

items.q: How does the recipient use the gift card?
items.a: She opens the link, writes her name on the card and books online or on WhatsApp. At the studio she gives the card's code and its value comes off when she pays for the visit.

faq.body: The questions we hear most in the studio, answered plainly. If yours isn't here, message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: How much do acrylic nails cost in Sabaneta?
items.a: A full set of sculpted acrylic nails costs {price:acrylic-sculpted} and includes the complete structure. A maintenance refill costs {price:acrylic-refill}. These prices cover simple designs; the full menu, with timings and every technique, is in the services section.

items.q: What is the difference between polygel and acrylic?
items.a: Acrylic blends polymer and monomer: maximum strength and a shape sculpted with a file, ideal for long extensions. Polygel is a putty gel cured under an LED lamp — lighter, more natural to wear, and odourless. A polygel full set costs {price:polygel-sculpted}.

items.q: How often do I need a refill?
items.a: We recommend a refill every 21 days at most, which keeps the structure even and the natural nail healthy. Every full set includes up to three refills at that pace. Leave it longer and the nail grows out enough that a fresh set is the better option.

Yes. We work by appointment only so each service gets its full time — a full set takes around two and a half hours. You can book over WhatsApp. We are open Monday to Saturday from 13:00 to 19:00; closed on Sundays and public holidays.

We are at Calle 69 Sur #43a - 41, first floor, in Sabaneta, Antioquia — half a block from the Registraduría and a short walk from Parque de Sabaneta. You can open the exact location in Google Maps from the contact section.

items.q: How do you handle hygiene and sterilisation?
items.a: Every disposable item is opened in front of you when your service begins, and reusable tools are sterilised between appointments. It is a fixed protocol, not something you have to ask for — we would rather you watch it happen than take our word for it.

diccionario.body: Each technique has its own logic, duration and ideal nail type. A quick guide so you know what to ask for — and why.
diccionario.fallback: You can also message us on WhatsApp if you'd like personal advice.

items.name: Acrylic
items.body: A mix of polymer and liquid monomer molded onto the nail. The classic system: maximum strength and sculpted shape via filing. Ideal for long extensions and architectural designs.

items.name: Polygel
items.body: A moldable paste-gel applied with a dual-form. Lighter than acrylic, feels natural and allows clean extensions. LED-cured — no odor. Recommended for thin nails or anyone seeking discretion.

items.name: Builder gel
items.body: A thick gel cured under UV/LED. A structural layer that protects the natural nail without extending it much. Polished finish, high durability and minimal wear on removal.

items.name: Dipping
items.body: A manicure technique using acrylic powder for a resilient, lightweight and long-lasting finish. Ideal for strong, glossy and natural-looking nails for weeks.

items.name: Semi-permanent
items.body: Long-lasting gel polish cured under a UV/LED lamp. Glossy, lightweight and natural finish — keep your nails flawless from simple designs to creative nail art.

items.name: Press On
items.body: Ready-to-wear nails that deliver a quick manicure in different shapes, lengths and custom designs, with no sculpting required.
